_comment: Workbook exercise air-sat-reset (docs/workbook/air-sat-reset.md), lbnl-ddahu part: the cold deck's supply-air temperature (CSA_TEMP, mapped as supply_air_temp) against OAT. `camber datasets config lbnl-ddahu --exercise air-sat-reset--lbnl-ddahu --store DIR --out cfg.json` fills in the store path. The setpoint CSA_TEMPSPT is not mapped (it is 55.0 in every row; see the data issue economizer-sat-reset-absent), so supply_air_reset reads the reset from the supply air's shape alone; supply_air_reset_compliance compares it with the Guideline 36 OAT reset target at its defaults. Both judge fan-on (CSF_CS), operate-mode (SYS_CTL) samples. The hot deck is not judged: it heats to its own setpoint by design.
